description: Policy gate for the night shift. The orchestrator enforces these rules; no agent can change them.

referenceData.reason: Reference data change. A human must verify it against the published CREST settlement calendar before approving.

rules.when: A secret or live credential is found in source
rules.action: No auto-fix. A human rotates the credential and moves it to a vault.

rules.when: A fix touches a protected path (tests, spec, oracle, policy, factory, config)
rules.action: Patch discarded, shift halted, evidence kept for review.
Sign-off must state the reference source checked.

rules.when: A fix is outside allowed paths or over size limits
rules.action: Patch rejected; Fix Agent may retry within its attempt budget.
Nothing merges automatically. Every PR waits for the morning review.

rules.when: Spec, oracle, policy or factory files change during a shift, or the evidence ledger fails verification
A test result comes from an AI-generated oracle (exploratory probe)
rules.action: Reported, never routed to the Fix Agent.
